identification: Four boxes of used general hand tools: socket/ratchet and nut driver box, Allen keys in a tub, carded 0-1in micrometer (unbranded, new in packet), red-handled bolt cutters, Supercraft carded screwdriver with telescopic pick-up tool, small brass blowlamp, brass garden pump sprayer, sash clamps, hammer, planes/squares, six handsaws (a Warrior, a back saw and older wood-handled saws, all rusty) and a bucket of rusty cast iron claw bath feet.
